name: procuraos
description: AI-assisted enterprise procurement and supplier collaboration platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @procuraos/api" "npm run dev -w @procuraos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @procuraos/api && npm run build -w @procuraos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @procuraos/api && npm run typecheck -w @procuraos/web
